For large Tier‑1 suppliers, Azure DevOps simplifies ASPICE compliance because you can extend the process templates with work item types like “System Requirement” or “Safety Goal” and enforce state transitions. #### Core Capabilities [...] #### Best For

Automotive teams that want a Jira alternative they can run on‑premise, need native traceability and documentation integration, and refuse to pay for half a dozen plugins just to get basic compliance coverage.

### Azure DevOps

#### Product Overview

Azure DevOps is Microsoft’s suite covering Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans, and Artifacts. It is widely used in automotive for software‑heavy ECU development, especially when teams already inhabit the Microsoft ecosystem. The on‑premise version, Azure DevOps Server, offers the same interface as the cloud service.

Teams using Azure Devops in production should document which controls it supports—access, change management, monitoring, personnel, or documentation—and automate exports where APIs allow. Manual quarterly screenshots rarely survive auditor sample requests across a Type II observation window.
